_comment: Runtime configuration for the daily crawl. `feeds` needs no code: add an RSS/Atom URL or a listing page and the generic adapter picks it up on the next run.

settings._requireDomainMatchNote: Publish only events matching a real NFSU domain. Every CTF is exempt: a capture the flag is a security competition by definition. Set false to accept any hackathon that clears minScore.

curated._note: Hand-maintained entries in data/curated.json. Needs no network.

hackerearth._note: Disabled 2026-09-08: every endpoint returns 403 from CI. Re-enable if it opens up.

mygov._note: The one Government of India source reachable from CI. Carries ministry challenges and the Smart India Hackathon.

pib._note: Disabled 2026-09-08: pib.gov.in serves Access Denied to data-centre IPs. Use data/curated.json, or run the crawl on a self-hosted runner with an Indian IP and re-enable.

feeds.label: Nullcon
feeds.note: Runs Battle Underground CTF and HackIM.

_removedFeeds._note: Probed 2026-09-08 and unreachable from GitHub Actions. Kept here so the reason is not lost. Restore them if the crawl moves to a self-hosted runner on an Indian network.
